project.purpose: Filesystem-to-MCP Skill advisory discovery and exact binding; source/consumer truth is distinct from installed Skill visibility.

nodes.label: SkillPackageAdmission
nodes.responsibility: Discover configured Skill sources and parse/scan source packages subject to declared trust, containment and eligibility constraints.
inputs: configured SkillSource roots and package bytes
outputs: source health, admitted records and quarantined/error diagnostics
behavioralContract: Unsafe paths and hostile packages are rejected or quarantined; no execution or implicit trust upgrade
acceptance: Source catalog and security tests provide adversarial package cases
formalObligations: Package provenance/containment and parser soundness under configured filesystem assumptions UNKNOWN
nodes.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_DECLARATION_ONLY; dynamic consumer, formal implementation, installed status UNKNOWN

nodes.label: SkillVisibilitySearch
nodes.responsibility: Project context-qualified, precedence-resolved visible Skill metadata and ranked search candidates from admitted records.
outputs: snapshotRevision, model-visible records and matching metadata
behavioralContract: Visibility is scoped to invocation mode and context; search must not imply execution, installed reachability or automatic Tool authority
acceptance: Native skills.search MCP tool invokes catalog.search and returns snapshot identity
formalObligations: Source-snapshot-to-search completeness within configured roots; unknown outside roots
nodes.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_DECLARATION_ONLY; dynamic consumer, formal implementation, installed status UNKNOWN

nodes.label: SkillExactBindingRead
nodes.responsibility: Resolve one exact Skill identity and read advisory Skill text under revision and content fences.
outputs: exact Skill binding or source-bound read projection
behavioralContract: Missing or stale Skill fails closed; read is bounded advisory content, never code execution or domain authority
acceptance: Gateway capability_resolve directly calls skills.resolve; Skills MCP delegates catalog.resolve/read_text
formalObligations: Cross-service snapshot/content drift and installed availability remain separately qualified
nodes.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_DECLARATION_ONLY; dynamic consumer, formal implementation, installed status UNKNOWN

nodes.label: SkillMcpProtocolSurface
nodes.responsibility: Expose bounded Skill search/resolve/read as standard MCP operations while preserving catalog authority and revision fences.
inputs: MCP tool request and configured catalog view
outputs: typed MCP tool response or scoped error
behavioralContract: Adapter does not own discovery policy, execute Skills, grant Agent rights or imply downstream completion
acceptance: Gateway consumes skills.resolve through routed MCP client; tool-level negative tests run
formalObligations: Protocol-to-core behavioral refinement and installed MCP release currentness UNKNOWN
nodes.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_DECLARATION_ONLY; dynamic consumer, formal implementation, installed status UNKNOWN
